subject: IT scoping call notes
body:
Scoping call held with Beacon's head of operations technology. Scope agreed: systems inventory, cyber assessment, integration and separation cost estimate, final report by day 30.
Beacon runs a third-party TMS and an in-house WMS built in 2019. No dedicated security lead. Cyber assessment will need a two-day site visit.
Next step: Beacon to send the license schedule.
